Blondie – Call Me / Giorgio Moroder – Call Me (Instrumental)

Original 1980 Chrysalis Records 45 RPM single featuring Blondie's chart-topping hit "Call Me," the iconic theme from the Paramount Pictures film American Gigolo. Written by Debbie Harry and Giorgio Moroder, this #1 hit became one of the defining songs of the new wave and disco era.

The B-side features the rare instrumental version by Giorgio Moroder, making this an especially desirable pressing for collectors and DJs.

  • Artist: Blondie
  • Title: Call Me
  • B-Side: Call Me (Instrumental) – Giorgio Moroder
